title: NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary:
Planned maintenance in NSW was scheduled between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on 21 October 2026, with a single interruption of about 15 minutes around 1:00 AM AEDT. The upstream provider has marked the work as completed.

nbn is performing planned maintenance to deploy new software on the eNodeB and site controller. This update forms part of routine network maintenance to help keep services running reliably.

nbn® is updating software on network equipment in your area. You will experience a loss of connection to your nbn service while this update takes place. 
Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected while your service is offline. Minimise disruption to your routine by downloading required files and switching to offline work modes.

updates.content:
An upstream provider will carry out planned maintenance on access network equipment in New South Wales between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on 21 October 2026. During this window, some services may briefly lose connection. A single interruption of about 15 minutes is currently scheduled around 1:00 AM AEDT.

We will monitor progress and update this notice if timings change. If you need to stay connected, please consider using mobile data during the brief interruption. Thank you for your patience.
The planned maintenance has been marked as completed as of 8:01 AM AEDT on 21 October 2026. No further interruption is expected from this work.
